scope: Theorem 15.1 (Conditional-product transfer) of the manuscript “From partial permutation information to Fourier bounds” (preprints/From-partial-permutation-information-to-Fourier-bounds-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 238 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 88926b5e48099ed8), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 49. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Put C0 = 2,000,000, and fix an integer L ≥ 2C0. Let V = A ⊔ C, where |A| = |C| = h and L divides h. Partition each half into L buffers of size h/L, and put H = SA × SC ⊆ SV . Let ξ be a subprobability on SV such that, for J = A, C and every ordered injection v : J −→ V , ξ{x : x−1 |J = v} ≤ 2UV {x : x−1 |J = v}. (15.1) Let Z have any probability distribution. Measurably in z, let tz ∈ SV and let νz A, νz C be subprobabil- ities on SA, SC, respectively. Suppose that for almost every z, each J = A, C, each of its buffers B, and every ordered injection w : J \ B −→ J, νz J {y : y|J\B = w} ≤ 2UJ {y : y|J\B = w}. (15.2) Regard the product νz A ⊗ νz C as a measure on H and set ω = EZ  δtZ ∗ (νZ A ⊗ νZ C )  , θ = ω ∗ ξ. Then, for all sufficiently large h, every irreducible representation of SV with Dλ > 1 satisfies ∥b θ(λ)∥op ≤ K0D −1/40 λ , K0 = √ 22. (15.3) The threshold on h and the constant K0 are independent of the environment, the transporters and all the measures.
